hook: Give your cat room to stretch.
caption:
#ad Getting your cat to the destination is simpler when your hands stay free. This soft backpack carrier features breathable mesh windows on the sides and front for clear visibility. The rear panel zips open to reveal an expandable mesh section, giving extra space to lounge during stops.

brief: Expandable cat backpack carrier: a soft, breathable backpack with mesh windows that zips out into a bigger space so the cat can stretch. Makes vet trips and travel with a cat calmer and hands-free.
